error.description: Same text a human sees after `error:` on stderr.

ErrorKind.description: Machine-readable failure category in structured JSON errors (`kind` field).

oneOf.description: Merge, pick, rebase, or similar would introduce conflicts.
Object ingestion detected an SHA-1 chosen-prefix collision (sha1dc).
Checkout or switch would overwrite local or untracked files.
Refused because a merge, rebase, pick or revert is paused (finish or abort it first).
Invalid `--author`, `--grep`, pickaxe, or similar filter pattern.
Invalid command arguments for a specific subcommand (exit code 2).
Incompatible flag combination (often with `--json` / `--markdown`).
A lock file such as `.git/index.lock` or a ref lock already exists (another process, or a stale lock); the lock is left alone (`lock.path`, `lock.holder`).

Deprecated alias of `lock_held`, emitted by v0.5.21 for a held index lock. grit no longer emits it; it stays in the error schema for one release so v0.5.21 output still validates, and will be removed after that.
Branch already exists on create.
Named branch does not exist.
`grit switch -` when there is no previous branch in the reflog.
Branch name failed validation.
Delete refused: branch is not fully merged.
Branch is checked out in this or another worktree.
Repository has no commits yet.
`--start` / tracking start point could not be resolved.
Upstream is not a tracking branch.
Branch has no upstream configured.
Other branch operation failure.
A hook exited non-zero (`hook.name`, `hook.status`, `hook.stdout`, `hook.stderr`).
A branch, tag, commit id or revision expression names nothing.
Clone, fetch, pull, push, or `remote refs` could not reach or read the remote (exit 128).
Push has no remote: none was named and no `origin` is configured.
A named remote is not configured.
A configured remote has no URL.
The server wants credentials and none were available.
The server rejected the credentials that were sent.
`merge --continue` found conflicts that are not resolved (or not staged) yet (`paths`).
Staged or unstaged changes block the operation (`paths`).
Worktree file I/O failed on a named path (`paths`, often one entry).
A checkout stopped part way and could not put some worktree paths back (`paths`); `HEAD` and the index are unchanged.
Git directory I/O failed on a named path under `.git/` (`paths`, often one entry).
Index-only commit while the work tree has unstaged or untracked changes.
Genuinely nothing to commit (clean tree or auto-stage cancel-out).
`HEAD` is on a GitButler workspace, which GitButler rewrites; commit with `but commit`.

HookFailureJson.description: A hook that exited non-zero, when `kind == "hook_failed"`.

stderr.description: What the hook wrote to stderr (lossy UTF-8).

stdout.description: What the hook wrote to stdout (lossy UTF-8).

LockHeldJson.description: The lock file that blocked the command, when `kind == "lock_held"`.

holder.description: Process recorded in the lock's pid sidecar (`core.lockfilePid`); absent when none was written.

path.description: Lock file that already exists (for example `/repo/.git/index.lock`).

LockHolderJson.description: Process recorded as the owner of a held lock.

pid.description: Process id from the pid sidecar.

running.description: Whether that process is running; `false` means the lock is stale.

StructuredJsonError.description: JSON object emitted on stdout for structured command failures.

commit.description: Commit that could not be replayed cleanly, when `kind == "conflict"`.

hint.description: The next command to run, in prose (also printed as `hint:` on stderr).

hook.description: The failing hook and what it wrote, when `kind == "hook_failed"`.

oid.description: Plain SHA-1 digest for colliding input, when `kind == "hash_collision"`.

paths.description: Repository-relative paths the failure is about, when `kind` is `unmerged_paths` or `dirty_worktree`.

refs.description: Other branches (full ref names) whose replay onto the rewritten history conflicted, when `kind == "conflict"` comes from a history rewrite or rebase.

WouldOverwriteJson.description: Paths that would be overwritten, when `kind == "would_overwrite"`.

description: Any `--json` failure object on stdout (schema contract only; see `error.v1.json`).
